<h2 class="white margin-top-none h2-v1-5 margin-bottom-sm" style="text-align: center;">Improve Outcomes</h2>
<p class="large-text white font-weight-light max-width-lg margin-horizontal-auto" style="text-align: center;">We believe education is the most powerful way to improve outcomes. With access to the highest quality continuing education, patient education, and home exercise programs, MedBridge gives you and your patients the tools needed to improve clinical outcomes.</p>
</div>
</div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="panel-grid panel-has-style padding-vertical-lg border-bottom-gray panel-edge-padding-lg--below-md panel-text-align-disabled panel-cell-alignment--center panel-collapse--right-top panel-stretch--full" id="pg-7405-8"><div class="panel-row-style panel-row-style-for-7405-8" data-stretch-type="full"><div class="panel-grid-cell" id="pgc-7405-8-0"><div class="so-panel widget widget_sow-editor panel-first-child panel-last-child" data-index="11" id="panel-7405-8-0-0"><div class="panel-widget-style panel-widget-style-for-7405-8-0-0" id="widget--arppmqeb"><div class="so-widget-sow-editor so-widget-sow-editor-base">
<div class="siteorigin-widget-tinymce textwidget">
<h2 class="margin-top-none">Earn all your CEUs in One Place</h2>
<p>We provide the highest quality online education taught by industry-leading professionals. Our evidence-based video courses provide a convenient, cost-effective solution to expand your knowledge, better serve your patients, and advance your career.</p>
<ul>
<li>A growing library of over 1600 accredited courses and live webinars across multiple disciplines and specialties</li>
<li>Engaging presentations with live patient demos, 3D models, and motion graphics</li>
<li>Case-based learning assessments to test your knowledge and handouts for use in everyday practice</li>
</ul>
<p><a href="/course-catalog">Browse courses</a> or <a href="/continuing-education">learn more</a></p>
</div>

<div class="siteorigin-widget-tinymce textwidget">
<h2 class="margin-top-none">Increase Patient Engagement</h2>
<p>Engage your patients in their recovery. Our easy-to-build home exercise programs are an extension of your practice in your patient’s home. Give your patients the tools they need to stay disciplined and get better faster.</p>
<ul>
<li>Over 5,000 video-based exercises and 250 patient education resources for different specialties and conditions</li>
<li>Easy-to-build programs with drag and drop functionality, pre-built templates, and smart search</li>
<li>HIPAA-compliant online patient portal, mobile app, patient satisfaction surveys, and tools for easy documentation in your EMR</li>
</ul>
<p>Learn more about <a href="/home-exercise-program">Home Exercise Program</a> or <a href="/patient-education">Patient Education</a></p>
</div>
</div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="panel-grid panel-has-style padding-vertical-lg panel-edge-padding-lg--below-md panel-text-align-disabled panel-cell-alignment--flex-start panel-stretch--full" id="pg-7405-10"><div class="panel-row-style panel-row-style-for-7405-10" data-stretch-type="full"><div class="panel-grid-cell" id="pgc-7405-10-0"><div class="so-panel widget widget_sow-editor panel-first-child panel-last-child" data-index="15" id="panel-7405-10-0-0"><div class="padding-vertical-md panel-widget-style panel-widget-style-for-7405-10-0-0" id="widget--uxhgerbi"><div class="so-widget-sow-editor so-widget-sow-editor-base">

<p class="large-text white font-weight-light max-width-lg margin-horizontal-auto" style="text-align: center;">Hundreds of private practices, hospitals, and skilled nursing facilities use MedBridge Enterprise to fuel their successful training programs and keep their workforce sharp.
